summary: High-performance HTTP File Server & WebSocket Pub/Sub Broker for Cables Standalone. Hosts static files, SSE streams, REST API endpoints, and real-time WebSocket communication.

ports.name: Hostname
ports.text: Interface to listen on (default 127.0.0.1 for local, or 0.0.0.0 for LAN).

ports.name: Port
ports.text: TCP port number to bind the server to (default 8080).

ports.name: Root Directory
ports.text: Local file system directory to serve files from. Defaults to the current patch directory.

ports.name: Auto Start
ports.text: If true, starts the server automatically when the patch loads.

ports.name: Start Server
ports.text: Trigger button to manually start the server.

ports.name: Stop Server
ports.text: Trigger button to manually stop the server.

ports.name: Enable SSE
ports.text: Enable Server-Sent Events endpoint.

ports.name: SSE Route
ports.text: URL path for SSE client connections (default /sse).

ports.name: SSE Event Name
ports.text: Name of the SSE event emitted on broadcast.

ports.name: SSE Data
ports.text: JSON payload to broadcast to connected SSE clients.

ports.name: Broadcast SSE
ports.text: Trigger to broadcast the SSE payload to all clients connected to the SSE route.

ports.name: Enable API
ports.text: Enable custom REST API endpoint (/api).

ports.name: Enable WS
ports.text: Enable integrated WebSocket Pub/Sub server.

ports.name: Server Started
ports.text: Fires when the HTTP server has started listening.

ports.name: Server Stopped
ports.text: Fires when the HTTP server has shut down.

ports.name: Server Ready
ports.text: Fires once the server has passed health verification and is ready for connections.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True while the server is actively running.

ports.name: Server Instance
ports.text: Object reference containing server, wss, and pubsub broker for WebSocketPub, WebSocketSub, and WebSocketClients ops.

ports.name: HTTP Request
ports.text: Fires whenever an incoming HTTP API request is received.

ports.name: HTTP URL
ports.text: URL of the most recent HTTP request.

ports.name: HTTP Request Data
ports.text: Request details including method, pathname, headers, query, and parsed POST body.

ports.name: HTTP Response Data
ports.text: Node.js ServerResponse object allowing custom HTTP response handling.

ports.name: SSE Active Clients
ports.text: Number of currently active SSE stream clients.

ports.name: WS Active Clients
ports.text: Number of currently active WebSocket clients connected to the server.

ports.name: Error
ports.text: Error message string if binding or running fails.
